name: finance-ingestion-benchmark
description: High-performance financial data ingestion benchmark comparing Python and Node.js implementations

scripts.validate-config: npm run validate-config:python && npm run validate-config:node
scripts.validate-config:dev: npm run validate-config:python -- --env development && npm run validate-config:node -- --env development
scripts.validate-config:staging: npm run validate-config:python -- --env staging && npm run validate-config:node -- --env staging
scripts.validate-config:prod: npm run validate-config:python -- --env production && npm run validate-config:node -- --env production
scripts.health-check: npm run health-check:python && npm run health-check:node
scripts.quality:check: npm run quality:python:check && npm run quality:node:check
scripts.quality:fix: npm run quality:python:fix && npm run quality:node:fix
scripts.lint:check: npm run lint:python:check && npm run lint:node:check
scripts.lint:fix: npm run lint:python:fix && npm run lint:node:fix
scripts.format:check: npm run format:python:check && npm run format:node:check
scripts.format:fix: npm run format:python:fix && npm run format:node:fix
scripts.type:check: npm run type:python:check && npm run type:node:check
scripts.type:node:check: cd apps/node-ingestion && node scripts/quality.js type:check || echo 'TypeScript not configured for Node.js app'
scripts.security:check: npm run security:python:check && npm run security:node:check

author: Your Organization
